verdict.rationale: Close's docs state it publishes an OpenAPI spec at a stable JSON URL, and a hands-on probe got HTTP 200 for an openapi.json file containing the "openapi" key, confirming the spec can be downloaded in machine-readable form. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the spec's coverage and versioning, since the docs give only a one-line mention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: We publish an OpenAPI spec at: https://api.close.com/api/openapi.json
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://developer.close.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
